text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Victoire Pisa, who's been 
feeling a bit off lately, to a popular 
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I had heard rumors, but... it's such a 
serene place, isn't it... However—

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caaaw...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be a famous shrine 
visited by many, but not a single 
worshiper was in sight besides us. 
Instead, an abnormal number of crows 
welcomed us.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, are you here to visit the shrine? 
It's dangerous here, so please come this 
way for now—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, what on earth is going on with those 
crows...?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"They originally lived in the mountain 
behind us, you see. But recently, they 
suddenly swarmed into the shrine."

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
It's causing trouble because the visitors 
coming to pray are frightened. I'd rather 
not be rough, but at this rate we may have 
to consider extermination...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The crows must have their reasons 
too. ...Could you grant me a moment of 
your time?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you. My name is Victoire 
Pisa. Would you mind if we spoke for a 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caaaw, caaaaw!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, I want to help you all! At this 
rate, you'll be in grave danger! So 
please—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Please let me hear them. Your feelings...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, this is troubling...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, the crows were quite furious. I 
couldn't really get through to them..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, they kept glancing worriedly at 
the mountain behind us. Could the cause 
perhaps lie over there...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Victoire Pisa's suggestion, I 
got permission to enter the mountain 
behind the academy. And what was waiting 
there was—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, a pile of trash? How did that 
happen...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"With something like this around, Mr. Crow 
and his friends can't live in peace. If 
that's the case—"
choice_data_list: You're gonna tidy up, right? I'll help!
You're going to tidy up, right? I'll help!

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw, caaaw!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we finished gathering most of the 
scattered trash, a flock of crows flew in.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's the crows from the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It might not be 
completely back to how it was, but didn't 
it turn out quite clean?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'll let the shrine staff know, and ask 
them to make sure the mountain doesn't get 
littered again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"So please, would you kindly return to 
your original home?"

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Cawwwww!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as an exceptionally loud cry echoed 
out, something fell right in front of 
Victoire Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
How pretty... Is this an ore, perhaps? 
Fufu, did a crow drop its treasure here?
choice_data_list: Isn't that a present for you?
Isn't that a present for you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mr. Crow, how about this stone—huh? 
Mr. Crow? You're not here, are you...
choice_data_list:
Those were some mysterious crows, weren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it felt almost as if I were being 
tested. ...Though I'm sure it was just my 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a reward for her hard work, 
Victoire Pisa's condition rapidly improved 
before our very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...This is some trash I overlooked, isn't 
it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'll clean this up properly...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaah. What a hectic day it has been...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the crow problem was resolved, 
Victoire Pisa was exhausted from cleaning 
and ultimately didn't recover her 
condition.
